from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687644/attempts/d21481a4026048e6979815abbac7f6cc/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e0e75188.py')
def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid); m=len(grid[0])
    out=[[0]*(3*m) for _ in range(3*n)]
    for tr in range(3):
        for tc in range(3):
            block=[list(row) for row in grid]
            if tr==0: block=block[::-1]
            if tc==0: block=[row[::-1] for row in block]
            for r in range(n):
                out[tr*n+r][tc*m:(tc+1)*m]=block[r]
    return out
